ler uma pasta fora da pasta de trabalho: read a folder outside the working folder
sempre perguntar antes de mexer em plani: always ask before touching a spreadsheet, even in Auto mode

Regras que decidem o que o Claude faz so: Rules that decide what Claude does on its own, what it asks about first and what it never does. They apply on top of the mode chosen in the message box (Ask, Accept edits, Plan, Auto).
Ficam em <code>.claude/settings.json</co: They live in .claude/settings.json (shared) and .claude/settings.local.json (just yours) inside the folder: the same files Claude Code uses. The ones you create here go into settings.local.json.
Escolha uma pasta para ver e mudar as re: Choose a folder to see and change its rules.
O Claude faria sozinho: Claude would do it on its own
O Claude pediria o seu OK: Claude would ask for your OK
Para liberar: regra de \"fazer sem pergu: To allow it: an "allow without asking" rule {regra}
Esta ação passaria? Responde sem rodar n: Would this action go through? Answers without running anything, using the rules above (and those of the chosen folder).
O formato é o do Claude Code: <code>Ferr: The format is the same as Claude Code's: Tool(pattern). Bash is a command (* matches anything), Read is reading, Edit is creating or changing a file (patterns like in .gitignore: docs/**, *.xlsx; //c/... is a full path), WebFetch(domain:site.com) is a web page, mcp__connector is a connector. The order is: never beats always ask, which beats allow without asking.
Algumas proteções não mudam com regra: a: Some protections don't change with rules: protected files (Settings > Code mode) are never read or changed; a command that deletes or publishes asks even with Bash allowed, unless the rule is written for that command; and a workflow always asks for OK.
Cada ação do modo Code, de fluxo e de ro: Every action from Code mode, workflows and routines, with what was decided and why (keeps the last 5,000).
